manual.maintenance_kit.line2: {0}Among those Engineers that travel the world or spend much of their time in mines, one problem crystalizes itself.
manual.maintenance_kit.line3: Their tools require constant maintenance and carrying an entire workbench isn't viable.{0}
manual.maintenance_kit.line4: Fortunately, a maintenance kit can perform most minor repairs and re-configurations.{0}
manual.maintenance_kit.line5: A set of tools, wrapped in sturdy hemp cloth, the maintenance kit allows you to customize your tools much in the way the {0}Engineer's Workbench{1} does.{2}
manual.maintenance_kit.line6: No longer will you have to deal with resurfacing to change the head on your Mining Drill or head back to your workshop to configure your Ear Defenders.{0}
manual.maintenance_kit.line7: All of this can now be performed on the go with the Maintenance Kit!
